book.name: 2ª de Corintios
book.title: Yeets mrop kuu mkee Paba lo re zha yez Corinto

content: Ne tak nke nee rtsin Diox, kona naab nee lo goo kon dib ndroo leettsoo nee, bkayaa goo re kuu wen kuu ndelaaz Diox, per kayaat gooy taxal thib kuu nataagt.
Ne nal nak wiz kuu nzhon Diox xkiizaa. Nal nak wiz kuu mlaa reʼaa.
Neeka thib welt mtsowt nee neeka thib kuu went lo neeka thib zha, tsa yent cho looz rtsin nee.
Sinke nloo nee, lee nee nak zha kuu nke rtsin Diox, asta nxek nee ndriid nee yalti por re kuu ndeche nee ne por ndota re kuu went,
mdin zha nee, mloo zha nee tsib, mrezno zha nee, mke zha nee tsiin kuu kwathoz nati; nzo welt mdatta nee ne noga mriid nee win.
Ne lo reta kuu mriid nee, mloo nee nali nak nee, tak nlebee nee kuu wli, mxek nee reta yalti kuu mriid nee, wen ngok nee, tak nap nee Mbi Nayon chaan Diox, ne wlipaa nke leettsoo nee taben nee.
Noga mloo nee, lee nee nak zha kuu nke rtsin Diox, tak pur kuu wli ni nee, ne nap nee yalney chaan Diox, ne nlortsin nee xkiiz Diox kuu wli, par ntak nee ne par ngyo nee.
Nzo leettsa ntsow nataak zha nee ne nzo leettsa ngoo zha yalnathoy nee, nzo leettsa wen ni zha nee ne nzo leettsa nlooz zha nee. Mbez zha lee nee nkedi, per wlipaa kuu wli ndediz nee.
Nzo leettsa ntsowno zha nee taxal zha kuu nlebeet zha, tegal wen wen nlebee zha nee. Mera aguth zha nee, per bee nabanka nee; nteti zha nee, per nzhuth zha nee.
Tegal nabil nzhak nee, per thibka naley nzo leettsoo nee; tegal prob nee, per kwathoz zha mtsow nee ngok rik; ne tegal yent kwan nap nee, per reta kwaa nkeno nee.
Re goo wetsʼn ne btan na, zha yez Corinto, mndaa nee kwent pur kuu wli lo goo, kon dib ndroo leettsoo nee.
Nke leettsoo nee goo, nabizt ngok nee lo goo, per goo nket leettsoo goo nee, nabiz ngok goo lo nee.
Kona naabʼn lo goo, taxal naab thib zha lo zhiinn zha, bke leettsoo goo nee taxal nke leettsoo nee goo.
Reʼaa nak gwodoo chaan Diox kuu naban
Ndoblot tseya goo kon zha kuu nyelaazt Diox, tak gagt yo kuu wen kon kuu went, ne gagt tsaal xni kon yalkow.
Nzaalt leettsoo Jesucrist kon Maxuuy, kona gagt yo thib zha kuu nyelaaz Jesucrist kon thib zha kuu nyelaazt Jesucrist.
Neeka thib kuu yewalt nak kon gwodoo Diox ne kon gwodoo re diox re men yezlyu ree. Tak reʼaa nak gwodoo chaan Diox kuu naban. Taxal nzhab Diox:

content.text: ne lee re zha gak zha yez da. [Lv. 26:12; Ez. 37:27]
Broo goo xid re zha kuu went nak, beche goo lo re zha;
ne re goo gak xgann na ne rtsaap na,
tenzhee ne Zha Nabee kuu nzhaak ntsow reta kwaa. [2 Sam. 7:14; 1 Cr. 17:13; Is. 43:6; Jer. 31:9]
